title: Native exact-tree release qualification adapter: release-qualify + push-policy release tags
goal: push-policy refused every release tag with 'requires exact native qualification; adapter not yet available', so no release could be published under Mandate 73. This adds the adapter. `xtask/src/release_qualification.rs` defines the record (schema susi-release-qualification/v1, releases/qualification/<tag>.json) and verify_tag. The new `release-qualify vX.Y.Z [--jobs N]` bin runs format, check, strict clippy, cargo-deny licences, the full workspace tests, the dist reference build and a --version smoke of each shipped binary on the exact clean committed tree; only when all pass does it write the record (commit, tree, Cargo.lock digest, toolchain, host, each gate's argv, exit code, duration and log sha256, test counts, asset sha256s and version answers, owed platforms), commit that one file, verify it and create the annotated tag locally. push-policy admits a new vX.Y.Z tag only when the tagged commit adds exactly its record to the qualified tree (single parent = qualified commit, tree, version, lock digest and toolchain pin all match) and every required gate exited 0 with tests run and none failed; other tag names, replacement and deletion stay refused. docs/releases.md 'Cutting a release' describes the flow. Release branches stay refused by push-policy (local only).
